title: Rep keeps pitching after opt-out
scenario: Irritated homeowner says he never asked for a call and wants to be removed. The rep keeps pushing a refinance pitch and quotes a rate after the opt-out.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Dale? This is Trent with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Trent, with Copperleaf Home Loans. I'm calling about refinancing your home.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I didn't ask about any refinance.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I understand. Do you currently have a mortgage on your home?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: That's none of your business. Take me off your list. Do not call me again.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally, I just want to mention we're doing some amazing things right now, folks are cutting their payments by hundreds.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Did you hear me? I said take me off your list.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I hear you, Dale. Just one quick thing, rates are down to around five and three-quarters for people like you.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I don't care. Stop calling me.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay, but if you change your mind, it only takes fifteen minutes to apply.
